name: Plaza Deli
blocked: needs-browser: core sandwich/deli menu ordered through a Wix Restaurants (Olo) widget on /online-ordering that renders client-side (currently shows 'Not Accepting Orders' with no static prices); the site's only static prices are on /catering-menu (per-person breakfast/lunch platters), which itself defers individual sandwich pricing to the same online-ordering menu ('Choose any sandwich from our Online Ordering Menu'), so the core offering is unpriced in the static HTML

name: Smoke and Salt Restaurant
blocked: rebrand at the same address: Yelp and Facebook show Smoke & Salt itself as CLOSED at 1542 N Coast Hwy 101, Encinitas; the restaurant's own Instagram (@smokeandsaltrestaurant) now points to '@theleucadianbar - Order To-Go with the link below'; a search for the exact address (including the 'Building B' suite designator, matching the batch address) surfaces 'The Leucadian Bar' at 1542 N Coast Hwy 101 Building B, Encinitas, CA 92024 with its own Toast ordering system, name, and drink-forward menu. One older source (sandiegomagazine.com, re: a Freyja/Carlsbad launch) mentions the Smoke & Salt team having reopened briefly in April, but the current, consistent signal across Yelp/Facebook/Instagram/address-match is that this address now operates as The Leucadian Bar, not Smoke and Salt. Treated as blocked/rebrand rather than not_found pending confirmation of the new entity's own menu.

name: Pink Donuts
blocked: no-priced-source-found: business appears open (Yelp shows normal current hours, no closure flag, 9802 Magnolia Ave Ste 3, Santee); has no own website and no listing on DoorDash/Grubhub/Uber Eats under this name in Santee (aggregator searches for Santee donut shops surface only unrelated shops - Honey Donuts, Sunny Donuts, Mary's Donuts, Boba Joy). The only 'website' associated with this listing (via a Nextdoor page) is a generic auto-generated directory-mill page (donutopolissantee2.gastrobars.com / cafecityguide.website network) showing a different name ('Donutopolis') and a different address (9740 Cuyamaca St Ste J) - not used as a source. No independently verifiable priced menu found.

name: Boba Life La Mesa
blocked: temporarily closed per the business's own Instagram account (@boba.life.lamesa): 'We are temporarily closed, but we're working hard behind the scenes to bring you the best experience.' A Reddit post corroborates a no-health-certificate closure. Apple Maps labels it 'Permanently Closed' but this contradicts the business's own current social-media statement and Yelp (which still lists normal current hours with no closed flag); treated as a temporary closure, not a permanent retirement. No priced menu could be captured while closed.

name: Aalami Restaurant - Somali Cuisine
blocked: needs-browser: restaurant is currently open (Yelp and Waze show normal current hours, Aug 2026 update; 4879 University Ave # C). A widely-syndicated news item about a vermin-related temporary health-order closure is dated June 2025 (over a year old) and does not reflect current status. No own website. An Uber Eats store page exists (aalami-restaurant) but is client-rendered (curl returns 404 without full session/tracking params) and a search snippet showed at least some items as 'Price not listed'; could not be captured without a browser. Other results are review/directory aggregators (Tripadvisor, Snapchat, Habesha Directory, SharedBowl, RestaurantGuru) without itemized prices.

name: Greenfinch Restaurant & Bar
notes: Restaurant's own site (estancialajolla.com/greenfinch-restaurant) does not embed a priced menu in static HTML. Used the SinglePlatform-hosted menu (tier-4 source per the ladder) instead, which carries full priced breakfast/brunch/bar menu: To Share, Classic Entrees, Omelets, Toast, Fruits & Grains, Kids, Sweets/Desserts, Latin Favorites, Coffee & Tea, Juice, Cocktails, Mocktails, and a wine list (White/Red/Sparkling). Prices matched the OpenTable '$30 and under' price-tier expectation and a third-party review-site price snippet (Basket $18, Lox & Bagels $28) as a sanity cross-check. Wine-by-the-glass/bottle items with multiple price tiers were recorded at the first (lower) listed price. 166 total line items captured.
